basics.name: Héctor Angel Gómez Robaina
basics.label: Computer Engineer · Fullstack Developer
basics.summary: Computer Engineer focused on taking large language models to production: structured outputs enforced by JSON Schema, prompt caching and per-call usage accounting, always behind domain ports so the provider can be swapped without touching business logic. Four years building management and data analysis platforms with NestJS, React and PostgreSQL on hexagonal architecture, DDD and end-to-end testing.

work.name: ETECSA
highlights: Designed and built backend services with NestJS and PostgreSQL for internal data analysis and management platforms.
Implemented secure REST APIs for user management, reporting and statistical data used across the organisation.
Implemented CI/CD practices to improve software delivery efficiency, reducing errors and cutting deployment times by more than 80%.
Led the web performance improvement of the company's administrative products, mentoring on best practices, building dashboards and designing strategies.

Introduced AI assistants into the development cycle (specification → design → tasks → verified implementation), standardising the flow in repository guides and shortening the ramp-up time of each new feature.

work.name: Freelance — Dealernode and Visa4Cuba
highlights: Designed and implemented AI-driven dataset generation in Chaca from natural language descriptions, in three stages —planning, parallel per-schema design and assembly of ids and relations— on top of the Anthropic SDK, with structured outputs enforced by JSON Schema so the model's response is always valid and readable by the application.

Cut cost and latency of the generation with prompt caching over the stable context, model selection by task complexity and a one-call-per-schema fan-out with bounded concurrency, avoiding truncated responses and rate limit errors.

Built live generation tracking with Server-Sent Events (stages, progress and heartbeat against proxy timeouts) and per-call usage accounting —input, output, cache write and cache read tokens kept apart—, surfaced in a backoffice panel with the real cost per user and per turn.

Developed an AI assistant in Dealernode that builds workflows by conversing with the operator, with the provider isolated behind a domain port and three interchangeable implementations (Claude, OpenAI and a fake one for deterministic end-to-end tests), persisted conversations and context derived from the business model.

Audited and redesigned that AI communication layer: a response contract enforced rather than requested, patch operations on the graph instead of resending it whole, a provider error taxonomy with its own codes, calls moved outside transactions, and removal of personal and cross-tenant data from the context sent to the third party.
Built a unified component and tooling platform for the company's products, converging technically and speeding up product delivery for Dealernode and Visa4Cuba.

projects.name: Chaca
highlights: Isomorphic library (Node.js and browser, ESM and CommonJS) published on npm —v2.4.0, over 3,000 downloads in the last year— that generates relational fake data from a declarative schema and exports to json, csv, yaml, postgresql, mysql, sqlite, java, python and typescript, with a CLI and TypeScript types included.

Web platform (NestJS + React) around the library with AI-assisted generation, schema attachments (prisma, graphql, sql, csv, json) as the starting point of the design, and an administration backoffice.
Hexagonal architecture with a provider-free domain and test coverage over the whole generation path (plan, validation, normalisation, assembly and report).
